title: A Pod container restart hangs remote installs forever, silently
description: BLOCKS 1.4.5. This is the one a USER sees. In routes/downloadManager.js the only terminal path for outstanding remote deps is _failOutstandingRemoteDeps, and it fires solely when !remoteModels.isRemoteActive(). A container OOM-restart does NOT make remote mode inactive: the Pod is still there and the wrapper comes back healthy on the same URL. So _onRemoteStreamClosed reconciles, reconnects the SSE (successfully - the wrapper is fine), and waits for progress that can never arrive, because NOTHING RE-ISSUES THE INSTALL - the wrapper's in-memory install state died with the container. Reconnect backoff caps at 15s and _remoteReconnectAttempt is never bounded, so it retries indefinitely. The user gets 'recovering', then silence: no failure, no toast, no Retry, a frozen progress bar. Same silence-reads-as-progress class as MPI-539, which fixed the remote-INACTIVE case and left this one. Observed 2026-09-04: after the OOM at 22:10:51Z the app logged 'SSE closed ... 17 dep(s) outstanding - recovering' plus four 'remote dep reconcile failed: wrapper status 404' (the wrapper still booting), one more close at 22:24:39Z, then nothing for 70+ minutes while the Pod log showed only /health, /wrapper/stats, /wrapper/manifest and POST /wrapper/models/status polling at 200. Volume frozen at 60.6GB, 24.34GB of .part bytes byte-identical over 91s, Pod RAM 41MB/4GB. Needs: detect that the wrapper restarted (its install state is empty while the app still has deps outstanding) and either RE-ISSUE the install or fail the deps terminally with a real Retry. A stall that can never recover must reach a terminal state - see the toast-not-dialog note in _failOutstandingRemoteDeps.
